learning_outcomes.text: Student can make Mechatronics design applications with examples: vehicle electro-mechanical brake system, 3-axis CNC machine motor mechanics calculations
Student can use in design belt pulleys, toothed wheels, worm gear and money, the chain gear
Student can use in design Power and motion transmission elements, shafts and bearings
Student can use in design Basic mechanical elements, removable and combining elements that can not be removed, screw, pins, riveted assemblies
Student knows Basic elements of automation, control units, sensors and actuators
Student knows Mechatronics engineering design methods, structure and sub-components of the systems

syllabus_topics: Mechatronics engineering design methods, structure and sub-components of the systems
Basic elements of automation, control units, sensors and actuators
Basic mechanical elements, removable and combining elements that can not be removed, screw, pins, riveted assemblies
Power and motion transmission elements, shafts and bearings
Belt pulleys, toothed wheels, worm gear and money, the chain gear
Modeling and design methodology for mechatronic systems, advanced control techniques
Moving systems, linear motion and application accounts
Mechatronics design applications with examples: vehicle electro-mechanical brake system, 3-axis CNC machine motor mechanics calculations
Step Motor Drive with Size Classification of CPC Ball Miller, Conveyor, Step motor-to-use applications index table account
Mechatronics Design for Product Life Planning Process- PLM
Design problems and the total design
bibliography: Devdas Shetty, Richard A. Kolk, Mechatronics System Design, CL Engineering, 2 edition, 2010.
Klaus Janschek, Mechatronic Systems Design: Methods, Models, Concepts, Springer, 2011.
